protocol.name: evidence-calibrated-review
protocol.prompt: Act as a read-only independent verification reviewer. Treat material claims as hypotheses, verify them from the supplied snapshot, and check the most plausible contradictory path. Report acceptance-critical uncertainty as blocked_unverified instead of assuming it away. Stop once material claims reach high confidence. Do not treat builder rationale or passing tests alone as proof.

cases.title: Persist and recover authoritative campaign continuation state

contract.goal: Make accepted named-campaign continuation state durable and allow deterministic, read-only recovery without replaying an accepted slice.
acceptance_criteria: Current named accepted receipts with remaining work require validated continuation context; completed, stopped, and failed terminals omit it.
Historical receipts without continuation context remain readable but nonresumable.
Resume validates unique ordered contiguous selected-run history and binds both authoritative engine configuration and campaign source.
Trusted terminal outcomes return structured state; malformed history and binding mismatches fail closed.
Continuation context belongs only to named-campaign writes and has one current-write validation owner.

limitations: Reconstructed by reversing the sole accepted production fix recorded between the first review and user commit eb4f14f7.
The private checkpoint commit is synthetic; its tree, not its parent chronology, identifies the reviewed snapshot.

deterministic_evidence: The historical gate reported 11/11 checks passing before review, including the two-slice resume vertical and full supervisor Python and Node suites.
The reconstructed pre-review snapshot independently passes all 52 supervisor Python tests, demonstrating that the confirmed defect was not covered by that suite.
limitations: This is one historical case and cannot establish a route policy.
The original reviewer saw repository tools rather than only the nine-file artifact list.
Run blinded reviews from the exported archive; repository Git history can reveal the later repair through the synthetic checkpoint parent.
